architecture: G10 OS uses a React + TypeScript + Vite frontend.
Supabase is used for database and authentication services.
Supabase Edge Functions provide server-side functionality.
The internal G10 OS application and the public/customer-facing site are separate application surfaces.
Customer portal authentication has frontend, Supabase Auth, database-linking, and Edge Function components.
G10 Multi-Agent Builder is located in g10-builder and operates on the G10 OS repository.

knownIssues.name: Customer portal login
knownIssues.details: Customer creation currently works, but customer portal login can return Invalid login credentials. Investigation identified multiple possible provisioning, callback, recovery-state, redirect, and authentication-flow issues. No root-cause fix has yet been safely applied.

resolvedIssues.name: Internal application browser title
resolvedIssues.details: The internal G10 OS browser title was changed successfully to G10 OS and passed the Vite build.

importantFiles.purpose: G10 Multi-Agent Builder orchestration, investigation, modification, review, approval, backup, build, and rollback workflow.
Persistent shared project knowledge. Normal Builder code-modification proposals must not modify this file.
Customer portal login UI and authentication flow.
Customer portal application and authentication state handling.
Customer portal Supabase Edge Function including customer account provisioning and portal operations.
Adds customer portal status, setup state, and manager-side portal account functions. Important when diagnosing customer authentication and portal provisioning.

decisions: G10 Builder uses dynamic agent selection instead of running every agent for every request.
Agents share findings through the Builder rather than operating as isolated workers.
Current repository source code is authoritative when it conflicts with stored project knowledge.
Important code changes require review before user approval.
Changes require a visible exact diff before approval.
Changes require explicit user approval before application.
Builder creates a backup before applying approved changes.
Builder runs a build after changes and rolls back when the build fails.
Secrets and .env values must never be sent to OpenAI model prompts.
Supabase service-role or secret credentials must remain local and server-side.
AI-generated arbitrary shell commands must not be executed automatically.
Persistent project knowledge must not be automatically written from unverified agent findings.
G10 Builder should favor targeted file retrieval to minimize API token usage.
